container: Criminal justice reform focuses on creating a fairer system that emphasizes rehabilitation over punishment. By investing in education, mental health services, and job training, individuals in the justice system can successfully reintegrate into society. Restorative justice practices promote accountability while healing harm. Reducing mass incarceration and addressing racial disparities are key goals. Effective rehabilitation lowers recidivism, enhances public safety, and fosters stronger communities. Reform ensures that justice is not only blind but also compassionate and transformative.
